ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The lower left figure is a schematic diagram of the distribution of a river system in a certain drainage basin, and the lower right figure is a schematic diagram of the river discharge change curves observed at hydrological stations Jia and Yi before and after one local rainstorm within this drainage basin. Read the figures and answer: <image1> If, among places 1, 2, 3, and 4 in the left figure, only one place has a local rainstorm area and causes the runoff changes in the right figure, then in which area in the left figure is the local rainstorm area least likely to be located?

matched_variant_raw.rewritten_question_text:
The lower left figure is a schematic diagram of the distribution of a river system in a certain drainage basin, and the lower right figure is a schematic diagram of the river discharge change curves observed at hydrological stations Jia and Yi before and after one local rainstorm within this drainage basin. Read the figures and answer:

<image1>

If, among places 1, 2, 3, and 4 in the left figure, only one place has a local rainstorm area and causes the runoff changes in the right figure, then in which area in the left figure is the local rainstorm area least likely to be located?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The lower left figure is a schematic diagram of the distribution of a river system in a certain drainage basin, and the lower right figure is a schematic diagram of the river discharge change curves observed at hydrological stations Jia and Yi before and after one local rainstorm within this drainage basin. Read the figures and answer: <image1> If, among places 1, 2, 3, and 4 in the left figure, only one place has a local rainstorm area and causes the runoff changes in the right figure, then in which area in the left figure is the local rainstorm area least likely to be located?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left figure is a schematic diagram of the distribution of a river system in a certain drainage basin. In the figure are marked hydrological station Jia, hydrological station Yi, and four possible local rainstorm areas 1, 2, 3, and 4; beside the river reaches there are arrows indicating the flow direction. Place 4 is located on the downstream side of the river reach in the upper left near hydrological station Jia or on the outside side of the drainage basin, while 1, 2, and 3 are connected with tributaries, lakes, or river channels within the drainage basin. The right figure is a discharge-time curve. The two curves corresponding to hydrological stations Jia and Yi both show obvious rising water and falling water processes after the rainstorm, indicating that this local rainstorm caused runoff changes at the observed cross sections of the two hydrological stations. Reasoning: Since the right figure shows that both stations Jia and Yi have changes in runoff processes, the rainstorm area should be located upstream or within a connected drainage-basin range that can converge flow toward the control cross sections of the hydrological stations. Looking one by one at places 1, 2, 3, and 4, places 1, 2, and 3 are all located in areas connected with the river system and possibly converging flow toward the observation cross sections; whereas place 4 is on the downstream side of station Jia or on the outside side of the station, and rainfall runoff cannot then pass through hydrological stations Jia and Yi to form the discharge changes of the two stations shown in the right figure. Therefore the least likely location is place 4.

method.method_draft: 先描述左图水系：根据箭头确定各河段流向，标出甲、乙水文站的控制断面，再判断1、2、3、4各地降雨径流是否会经过甲、乙站。结合右图可知此次局地暴雨引起了甲、乙水文站的径流过程变化，因此暴雨区应至少位于能够向水文站断面汇流的上游区域。逐一检验四地，4地位于甲站下游侧或站外侧，不可能使径流再经过甲、乙站并形成右图所示观测变化，所以最不可能为4地。

method.method_draft: 先描述右图：甲、乙站对应的两条流量过程线都出现暴雨洪峰，但峰现时间和峰形不同，可解释为同一暴雨径流沿水系传播并受河道或湖泊调蓄影响。然后回到左图，分别看四个候选地到甲、乙站的水流路径是否能产生这种“一个站先响应、另一个站后响应且洪峰被削弱”的关系。1、2、3位于流域内部或上游支流，存在通过湖泊/河道向水文站传播的可能；4地位于甲站下游侧或水文站控制范围之外，若在此暴雨，不能形成右图所示两个水文站的先后洪峰响应，因此判为最不可能位置。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：右图是甲、乙两水文站在暴雨前后的流量过程线示意图，两条曲线都出现明显洪峰；其中一条洪峰出现较早、峰值较高且较尖，另一条洪峰出现较晚、峰形较缓，说明同一次局地暴雨产生的径流可能先影响一个水文站，再沿河道或经湖泊调蓄后影响另一个水文站。左图显示该流域内有甲、乙两个水文站、湖泊及1、2、3、4四个候选暴雨区；图中河流流向表明，1、2、3位于流域内部或相关上游支流、湖泊附近，降雨径流有可能通过河道或湖泊传输到两个水文站，并形成先后不同的洪峰响应。4地位于甲水文站下游侧或水文站控制范围之外，若局地暴雨发生在4地，其径流不可能再向上游影响甲、乙两个水文站，也难以造成右图所示两站均有洪峰且存在先后传播、削弱的过程。因此最不可能的位置是4地。

The lower left figure is a schematic diagram of the distribution of a river system in a certain drainage basin, and the lower right figure is a schematic diagram of the river discharge change curves observed at hydrological stations Jia and Yi before and after one local rainstorm within this drainage basin. Read the figures and answer: <image1> If, among places 1, 2, 3, and 4 in the left figure, only one place has a local rainstorm area and causes the runoff changes in the right figure, then in which area in the left figure is the local rainstorm area least likely to be located?
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot:
Image description: The left figure is a schematic diagram of the distribution of a river system in a certain drainage basin. In the figure are marked hydrological station Jia, hydrological station Yi, and four possible local rainstorm areas 1, 2, 3, and 4; beside the river reaches there are arrows indicating the flow direction. Place 4 is located on the downstream side of the river reach in the upper left near hydrological station Jia or on the outside side of the drainage basin, while 1, 2, and 3 are connected with tributaries, lakes, or river channels within the drainage basin. The right figure is a discharge-time curve. The two curves corresponding to hydrological stations Jia and Yi both show obvious rising water and falling water processes after the rainstorm, indicating that this local rainstorm caused runoff changes at the observed cross sections of the two hydrological stations.
Reasoning: Since the right figure shows that both stations Jia and Yi have changes in runoff processes, the rainstorm area should be located upstream or within a connected drainage-basin range that can converge flow toward the control cross sections of the hydrological stations. Looking one by one at places 1, 2, 3, and 4, places 1, 2, and 3 are all located in areas connected with the river system and possibly converging flow toward the observation cross sections; whereas place 4 is on the downstream side of station Jia or on the outside side of the station, and rainfall runoff cannot then pass through hydrological stations Jia and Yi to form the discharge changes of the two stations shown in the right figure. Therefore the least likely location is place 4.
